278869274.description:
A polished agate geode half cut to stand upright on its flat base. The sawn face is polished smooth and shows concentric banding in deep magenta, pink, peach and pale gray, with a small druzy crystal pocket near the center. The coloring is characteristic of dyed agate. The outer rind is left natural with a rough tan and reddish brown crust. A small paper sticker remains on the base.

Condition: Minor chipping along the rough outer edges and top. Small paper sticker residue on the base. Polished face clean with light surface marks.

278960754.description:
This lot includes assorted mineral and crystal specimens featuring a variety of rough and tumbled stones. Colors include blue, green, purple, yellow, white, pink, and brown. Stone types present are quartz, amethyst, jasper, aventurine, sodalite, rose quartz, pyrite, and possibly agate. Sizes vary from small tumbled stones to larger rough chunks. Most stones are in natural, unpolished condition, with a few polished pieces included. No brand or manufacturer indicated. Suitable for collectors, educational purposes, crafting, or metaphysical use.
